title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramelised Banana Pancake 10ml  E-Liquid
description: Caramelised Banana Pancake by Vampire Vape Desserts delivers the rich taste of golden banana slices seared in syrupy sugar, layered over a warm, buttery pancake base. This dessert-inspired e-liquid captures the familiar comfort of a classic pancake stack, pairing smooth banana flavour with notes of caramelised glaze and subtle pastry notes. Available in a choice of 0mg, 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg freebase nicotine strengths, this e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with starter kits, pod systems, and vape pens. The 3mg strength is blended at a balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, while the 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths feature a 40VG/60PG ratio for a more pronounced throat hit and flavour. Each 10ml bottle is produced in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, offering a flavourful option for vapers who enjoy rich, dessert-themed profiles crafted by one of the UK’s most iconic e-liquid brands. Also available in High-VG Shortfills and DIY Concentrates.
